player_prompt.intro:
Uyadlala igemu lezahluleko za Countdown!
Inhloso: Qhathanisa nambari ngokusebenzisa +, -, *, / ukufikela inhlako.
Isiko lesingeweli: [i j op] lapho i,j zingamagama asendaweni na op ingemunyano.
Kudla: [0 2 *] kuhlanganisa nambari ehlala kwindawo 0 nambari ehlala kwindawo 2.
Ukugijima kufanele kubuyekeza nambari ezintjengele.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yenkhetho ayikho ngendlela. Usebenzise `[i j op]` lapho i,j yinombolo zesikhundla kanti op yinketho +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Ema-indices langasebenti. Kumele ehluke futsi abe ngekhatsi kwebanga 0 -{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Umsebenti longasebenti (kuhlukaniswa nge-zero nobe umphumela longaphili)
